canon: Criatura flaca de cuatro patas, pelaje rojizo rasposo, mechones de pelo negro en los tobillos y patas desproporcionadamente largas; pelaje enredado con parches de arena fosilizada que brillan como vetas minerales rojas, hilera de púas oscuras erizadas en el lomo, colmillos curvos amarillentos exagerados, costillas marcadas, cola negra tupida que borra sus huellas.
fuentes: backend/src/scripts/worldCatalog.ts:1479 (bio); backend/src/services/sexDimorphism.ts:99-111 (dimorfismo); detalle campo a campo en docs/producto/plan-imagenes/borradores/fichas-piloto.json

prompt.sujeto: A long, low-slung pack hunter with a very long, stretched body carried close to the ground on short, sturdy legs with dark curved claws, about as long as an adult orc is tall.
prompt.ancla: a red fox stretched to the length of a weasel
prompt.cuerpo: Its narrow fox-like head has tall pointed ears, an amber eye and two long, pale sabre fangs hanging down past its lower jaw. The short, dense coat is a warm rust brown, paler along the flanks in faint stripes.
rasgos: A crest of overlapping black armoured plates runs along its spine from the neck to the tail, edged with a row of sharp, glowing red spikes.
Its long banded tail ends in a dark, spiny tuft.
prompt.pose: It walks in profile across the whole width of the foreground, low to the ground, while the rest of the pack lopes behind it as dark shapes in the dust.
prompt.entorno: Around them stretches cracked red earth with sparse dry tufts, and dark whirling dust devils rise far off on the plain.

rasgos+: This male is heavier in the neck and shoulders, with longer fangs and a taller crest of spikes.
This female is visibly smaller and slighter, with a narrower head and a lower crest of spikes.

estacion:invierno.entorno: Around them stretches bare cracked red earth with a few short dry tufts, and dark whirling dust devils rise far off on the plain.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore
